title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
summary: Introduces the ReAct framework combining chain-of-thought reasoning with interactive action execution. Shows that interleaving reasoning ('thought') and acting ('action' -> 'observation') enables language models to overcome hallucination in reasoning and error propagation in action execution.
copyright_notice: Academic preprint under arXiv non-exclusive distribution license; metadata and fair use excerpts.

title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
summary: Demonstrates that language models can self-learn tool usage through self-supervised API call generation, execution, filtering based on perplexity reduction, and fine-tuning without human annotations.
copyright_notice: Academic preprint under arXiv distribution license; metadata and fair use excerpts.

title: Building Effective Agents
summary: Practical engineering guide distinguishing deterministic workflows from autonomous agents. Outlines key patterns including Prompt Chaining, Routing, Parallelization, Orchestrator-Workers, and Evaluator-Optimizer, advocating for starting with simple architectures before adding complexity.
verified_sections: When (and when not) to use agents
When and how to use frameworks
copyright_notice: Copyright Anthropic Engineering; educational citation and fair use analysis.

title: Choose your agentic AI architecture components
summary: Enterprise cloud reference architecture mapping foundational agent components: model runtimes, agent execution runtimes, memory architectures (short-term vs. long-term), tools (MCP, APIs, function calling), tool bloat mitigation, design patterns, and enterprise governance/security.
copyright_notice: Copyright Google Cloud Documentation; technical reference under fair use.

title: Agents SDK
summary: Official reference guide for OpenAI's Agents SDK in Python and TypeScript. Specifies agent encapsulation (model, instructions, tools), multi-agent hand-offs, guardrails, and execution tracing for production AI applications.
copyright_notice: Copyright OpenAI Developer Documentation; educational quotation and analysis.

title: LangGraph Overview
summary: Low-level orchestration framework and runtime for long-running stateful agents. Defines agents as cyclic graphs of shared state, nodes, and edges, providing durable execution via checkpointers, token/event streaming, and human-in-the-loop controls.
copyright_notice: Copyright LangChain Inc.; open documentation reference.

title: CrewAI Documentation & Repository
summary: Open-source framework designed for orchestrating autonomous role-playing AI agents. Formulates multi-agent systems via Agent roles, goals, backstories, Task assignments, and Crew execution processes (Sequential and Hierarchical).
verified_sections: Fast and Flexible Multi-Agent Automation Framework
Connecting Your Crew to a Model
copyright_notice: MIT Open Source License; CrewAI Inc.

title: Microsoft Agent Framework Overview
summary: Official overview of Microsoft Agent Framework. Unifies AutoGen's agent abstractions with Semantic Kernel's enterprise session management, type safety, telemetry, and middleware, adding graph workflows. Designates Agent Framework as the direct successor to AutoGen and Semantic Kernel.
verified_sections: Agent Framework brings together four primary areas
When to use agents vs workflows
